attrs.evidence: docs/spec/proof-wire/experiment/holdout_score_core.mjs compareObservations() + holdout_runner.mjs interop(). The comparator carries its own falsifier in the synthetic fixture: two identical documents must report 0 disagreements, and a mutated artifact_root that NO predicate reads must be FOUND. Gate `gov-nest`.
attrs.statement: INTEROPERABILITY IS A QUESTION ABOUT OBSERVATIONS, NOT ABOUT SCORES. P4.6 compared two implementations by their PREDICATE RESULTS, which compares only what the frozen predicates happen to read. MEASURED: mutating H4.candidate.C1.artifact_root in a second implementation's document -- an address no frozen predicate reads -- left both at 25/25 with BYTE-IDENTICAL result vectors while the observations plainly disagreed. Interop now deep-compares the normalized observation documents, every member, excluding only the producer label; any difference is an UNCLASSIFIED_FINDING that BLOCKS completion rather than printing underneath a PASS. AND THE TWO CLAIMS ARE SEPARATE: HOLDOUT-HARNESS asks whether each implementation satisfied the frozen predicates and one implementation may legitimately PASS it; HOLDOUT-INTEROP asks whether two frozen implementations saw the same thing and with fewer than two it is NOT MEASURED, never PASS. A green interoperability result over one implementation is a claim nobody measured.
